changes.added: A separate scalar implementation by the same executor verifies targets, scores, strict breaches, HAC diagnostics and maturity records. Its acceptance uses the registered absolute $10^{-10}$ plus relative $10^{-12}$ tolerance; integer identities and hashes are exact. Zero mismatches therefore denotes tolerance-based algorithm agreement, not byte-identical summation, another data acquisition, a second person or another finite-penalty solver fit. The complete audit and rounding discrepancies remain in the linked result readout.
